run: qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock")] | .[0].marketplace.screenshots[0].path'
qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock")] | .[0].marketplace.compatibility.minShellVersion'
qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock")] | .[0].marketplace.changelog[0].version'
qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock" and .state == "loaded")] | length'

horneroctl plugin community list >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo listed || echo refused
